newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Hazards of the tax collector in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Hazards of the tax collector in Russia.

text.p: Twenty-six Russian tax collectors were killed in the course of their work last year, 74 were injured, six were kidnapped and 41 had their homes burnt, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday.

The hazards of a Russian tax collector's life were outlined in a statement by the central inspectorate -- a body under strong pressure from the government to step up efforts to thwart widespread fraud in the emerging market economy.
The statement also said 18 taxation offices suffered bomb blasts and shotgun attacks. The inspectorate said it expected no change for the better in the new year.
